step1.description:
Today's a React stream. Let's talk Remix, Next, Edge deployment, and Server Components.

It's been over a year since the React Server Component announcement but I still haven't had the chance to dig into the demo. That changes today. There are a lot of different solutions in this space but I think React Server Components have a really unique take.
